title: Show BGP Neighbor Summary
description: Shows BGP neighbor state, uptime and prefix counts.
use_case: Use when a BGP peer is down or expected routes are missing.
check: Check whether the neighbor is established and whether prefixes are being received.

title: Show Routing Table
description: Shows the IPv4 routing table.
use_case: Use when checking route installation or next-hop selection.
check: Check route source, prefix, next hop, metric and outgoing interface.

title: Show Interface Summary
description: Shows interface IP addresses and line/protocol status.
use_case: Use for a quick interface health check.
check: Up/up is normally expected for an active routed interface.

title: Show ARP Table
description: Shows IPv4 ARP mappings.
use_case: Use for local L2/L3 reachability troubleshooting.
check: Confirm the expected IP-to-MAC mapping and interface.

title: Show BGP Neighbor Summary
description: Shows BGP peer state and prefix information.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting BGP peering or route exchange.
check: Check peer state, AS number, uptime and learned prefixes.

title: Show Routing Table
description: Shows the FortiGate routing table.
use_case: Use when validating static or dynamic routing.
check: Confirm the expected prefix, gateway and outgoing interface.

title: Show ARP Table
description: Shows the FortiGate ARP table.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting local neighbor reachability.
check: Confirm the expected IP, MAC and interface.

title: Show IPsec Tunnel Summary
description: Shows a summary of IPsec tunnel state.
use_case: Use when checking a site-to-site IPsec VPN.
check: Confirm the expected tunnel and security associations are present.

title: Packet Sniffer
description: Captures packets matching a filter.
use_case: Use to confirm traffic entering or leaving the firewall.
check: Inspect interfaces, source/destination, ports, flags and return traffic.

title: Show BGP Summary
description: Shows BGP peer status and summary information.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting BGP peering or route exchange.
check: Check peer state, AS, uptime and route counters.

title: Show Routing Table
description: Shows routes installed in the routing table.
use_case: Use when verifying route selection and next hops.
check: Confirm the expected route, next hop, metric and interface.

title: Show ARP Table
description: Shows ARP entries.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting local neighbor reachability.
check: Confirm the expected IP and MAC are learned on the correct interface.

title: Show IPsec Security Associations
description: Shows active IPsec security associations.
use_case: Use to verify IPsec Phase 2 state.
check: Confirm active SAs exist for the expected tunnel.

title: Show IKE Security Associations
description: Shows active IKE security associations.
use_case: Use to verify IKE/Phase 1 state.
check: Confirm an IKE SA exists for the expected peer.

title: Show license files
description: Displays installed license files.
use_case: Use when checking which license files are present.

title: Show license usage
description: Displays licensed feature usage and state.
use_case: Use when checking whether licensed features are installed or in use.

title: Show license details
description: Displays detailed license information.
use_case: Use for detailed license inspection.

title: Show license host ID
description: Displays the unique license host ID.
use_case: Use when identifying the switch host ID for licensing.

title: Find license files in bootflash
description: Filters bootflash for .lic files.
use_case: Use to locate Nexus license files.

title: Install license
description: Installs a license file from bootflash.
use_case: Use only when intentionally installing a valid license.

title: Back up installed licenses
description: Copies installed licenses to a tar archive.
use_case: Use before license changes or for backup.

title: Extract license archive
description: Extracts a tar archive from bootflash.
use_case: Use when restoring or extracting backed-up licenses.

title: Clear license
description: Clears a license from the switch.
use_case: Use only when intentionally uninstalling a license.

title: Update license
description: Updates an existing license using a replacement file.
use_case: Use only with the correct updated license file.

title: Enable grace period
description: Enables the license grace period.
use_case: Use when intentionally enabling license grace period.

title: Show features
description: Displays feature state in NX-OS.
use_case: Use to verify whether features are enabled or disabled.

title: Enable interface-vlan
description: Enables interface-vlan.
use_case: Use before SVI functionality where required.

title: Enable EIGRP
description: Enables EIGRP.
use_case: Use before EIGRP configuration.

title: Enable OSPF
description: Enables OSPF.
use_case: Use before OSPF configuration.

title: Show feature sets
description: Displays feature-set state.
use_case: Use to verify feature-set status.

title: Enable fabric feature-set
description: Enables the fabric feature-set.
use_case: Use only when intentionally enabling the feature-set.

title: Show interface status
description: Displays port status, VLAN, duplex, speed, and type.
use_case: Use as a first interface health check.

title: Show VRFs
description: Displays configured VRFs and state.
use_case: Use when checking VRF existence and state.

title: Check Telnet feature
description: Shows Telnet feature state.
use_case: Use to verify whether Telnet is enabled.

title: Show Telnet server
description: Displays Telnet service state.
use_case: Use to confirm Telnet server status.

title: Enable Telnet
description: Enables Telnet.
use_case: Use only when Telnet is intentionally required.

title: Check SSH feature
description: Shows SSH feature state.
use_case: Use to verify whether SSH is enabled.

title: Show SSH server
description: Displays SSH server status/version.
use_case: Use when checking SSH service state.

title: Show SSH key
description: Displays SSH key details.
use_case: Use when verifying SSH key properties.

title: Generate RSA key 2048
description: Regenerates a 2048-bit RSA key as shown in the workbook.
use_case: Use only in a controlled SSH-key replacement workflow.

title: Show user accounts
description: Displays local user accounts and roles.
use_case: Use to audit local users.

title: Show chassis model
description: Filters version output for chassis model.
use_case: Use to identify Nexus chassis model.

title: Show running image
description: Shows kickstart/system image information.
use_case: Use to identify running Nexus images.

title: Save configuration
description: Saves running configuration to startup configuration.
use_case: Use after approved configuration changes.

title: Show running configuration
description: Displays active configuration.
use_case: Use to inspect current configuration.

title: Show startup configuration
description: Displays saved startup configuration.
use_case: Use to inspect saved configuration.

title: Erase startup configuration
description: Erases startup configuration.
use_case: Use only for intentional reset/rebuild.

title: Reload switch
description: Reloads the system and FEX modules in the workbook example.
use_case: Use only during an approved maintenance window.

title: Show port profiles
description: Displays port-profile summary.
use_case: Use to inspect defined port profiles.

title: Show named port profile
description: Displays one port-profile.
use_case: Use to verify profile state and content.

title: Enable port profile
description: Enables a port-profile from profile configuration mode.
use_case: Use when activating a prepared profile.

title: Apply port profile
description: Applies a port-profile to an interface.
use_case: Use when attaching a profile to an interface.

title: Expand port profile
description: Shows effective interface configuration inherited from a profile.
use_case: Use to verify profile application.

title: Enable FEX feature
description: Enables FEX support.
use_case: Use before FEX configuration.

title: Show FEX status
description: Displays FEX discovery and operational state.
use_case: Use to verify whether a FEX is discovered or online.

title: Show FEX details
description: Displays detailed FEX state and mappings.
use_case: Use for detailed FEX troubleshooting.

title: Show specific FEX
description: Displays information about one FEX.
use_case: Use to verify one FEX.

title: Show FEX host ports
description: Filters interface status for FEX front-panel ports.
use_case: Use to inspect FEX host-facing interfaces.

title: Redistribute FEX pinning
description: Requests FEX pinning redistribution.
use_case: Use only during intentional FEX pinning changes.

title: Show vPC summary
description: Displays vPC domain, peer, keepalive, consistency, peer-link and member status.
use_case: Use as the first command for vPC troubleshooting.

title: Show peer keepalive
description: Displays vPC keepalive state and parameters.
use_case: Use when peer keepalive is down or unstable.

title: Show consistency parameters
description: Compares vPC consistency parameters.
use_case: Use when a vPC is down or suspended due to mismatch.

title: Show vPC role
description: Displays primary and secondary vPC roles.
use_case: Use during vPC failure analysis.

title: Show port-channel summary
description: Displays port-channel and member state.
use_case: Use to verify LACP/port-channel health.

title: Enable vPC feature
description: Enables vPC.
use_case: Use before vPC configuration.

title: Set vPC peer-link
description: Marks a port-channel as vPC peer-link.
use_case: Use only on the intended peer-link port-channel.

title: Assign vPC ID
description: Associates a downstream port-channel with a vPC ID.
use_case: Use when building a vPC member port-channel.

title: Show FabricPath IS-IS interfaces
description: Displays FabricPath IS-IS interface state and metrics.
use_case: Use to verify FabricPath interface readiness.

title: Show FabricPath adjacency
description: Displays FabricPath IS-IS adjacencies.
use_case: Use when checking FabricPath neighbors.

title: Show FabricPath switch IDs
description: Displays FabricPath switch-ID table.
use_case: Use to verify learned/local switch IDs.

title: Show local FabricPath switch ID
description: Displays the local FabricPath switch ID.
use_case: Use to verify a configured local switch ID.

title: Show FabricPath routes
description: Displays FabricPath unicast route table.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting FabricPath reachability.

title: Enable FabricPath feature-set
description: Enables FabricPath feature-set after installation as shown in the workbook.
use_case: Use only when intentionally enabling FabricPath.

title: Set FabricPath interface mode
description: Places an interface in FabricPath mode.
use_case: Use only on intended supported interfaces.

title: Set FabricPath switch ID
description: Configures a static FabricPath switch ID.
use_case: Use carefully because switch IDs must be unique.

title: Show VLAN mode
description: Shows VLAN mode information used to verify FabricPath VLAN mode.
use_case: Use to verify VLAN mode.

title: Show spanning tree VLAN
description: Displays spanning-tree state for a VLAN.
use_case: Use to verify STP state where applicable.

title: Show dynamic MACs in VLAN
description: Displays dynamic MAC entries learned in a VLAN.
use_case: Use to trace hosts and verify MAC learning.

title: Show monitor session
description: Displays a monitor session and its source/destination state.
use_case: Use to verify SPAN configuration.

title: Show all monitor sessions
description: Displays configured monitor sessions.
use_case: Use to inspect SPAN/ERSPAN/RSPAN sessions.

title: Create checkpoint
description: Creates a temporary configuration checkpoint as described in the workbook.
use_case: Use before planned configuration changes.

title: Show all virtual servers
description: Displays status and statistics for LTM virtual servers.
use_case: Use as a first check when a VIP/application is unavailable or not receiving traffic.

title: Show virtual server details
description: Displays operational status/statistics for one virtual server.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting a specific VIP.

title: List virtual server configuration
description: Displays full virtual-server configuration.
use_case: Use to inspect destination, pool, profiles, SNAT, persistence, iRules and policies.

title: Show all pools
description: Displays pool status and statistics.
use_case: Use to verify backend pool health after confirming the VIP.

title: Show pool members
description: Displays pool-member status and statistics.
use_case: Use when the VIP is up but backend traffic fails or is intermittent.

title: List pool configuration
description: Displays pool configuration including members, monitor and load-balancing method.
use_case: Use when validating pool design/configuration.

title: Show nodes
description: Displays node state and statistics.
use_case: Use when determining whether backend nodes are available independently of pool membership.

title: Show interfaces
description: Displays interface status and traffic/media information.
use_case: Use for basic BIG-IP physical/TMM interface troubleshooting.

title: Show trunks
description: Displays BIG-IP trunk state.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting link aggregation/LACP or aggregated connectivity.

title: List VLANs
description: Displays VLAN configuration.
use_case: Use to verify interface/trunk membership and VLAN configuration.

title: List Self IPs
description: Displays Self IP configuration.
use_case: Use to verify BIG-IP addresses, VLAN bindings and related network configuration.

title: Show routes
description: Displays BIG-IP routing information.
use_case: Use to verify reachability toward clients, gateways and pool members.

title: Show ARP table
description: Displays ARP entries.
use_case: Use when BIG-IP cannot reach a directly connected gateway or pool member.

title: Show connection table
description: Displays TMM connection-table entries.
use_case: Use to determine whether BIG-IP is creating traffic flows.

title: Filter connections by client
description: Filters connection-table entries by client-side address.
use_case: Use when tracing one client through BIG-IP.

title: Filter connections by VIP
description: Filters connection-table entries by client-side server/VIP address.
use_case: Use when tracing connections associated with a specific virtual server address.

title: Show persistence records
description: Displays persistence records.
use_case: Use when troubleshooting persistence/stickiness behavior.

title: Basic host capture
description: Captures full packets for a host across BIG-IP TMM interfaces.
use_case: Use after basic VIP/pool/routing checks require packet-level verification.

title: Capture host and port
description: Captures traffic for a host and service port.
use_case: Use to narrow capture scope to an application flow.

title: Save capture to PCAP
description: Writes a filtered full-packet capture to /var/tmp.
use_case: Use when the capture must be analyzed in Wireshark.

title: Read saved PCAP
description: Reads a saved packet capture on BIG-IP.
use_case: Use for quick on-box review of a previously saved capture.

title: Enhanced F5 flow correlation
description: Captures BIG-IP traffic with F5-specific flow/peer correlation metadata.
use_case: Use when correlating client-side and server-side traffic through the full proxy.

title: Capture SYN and RST
description: Captures TCP SYN/RST packets for a host.
use_case: Use when diagnosing handshake failures, resets or repeated connection attempts.

title: Enable tcpdump SSL provider
command: tmsh modify sys db tcpdump.sslprovider value enable
description: Enables the BIG-IP tcpdump SSL provider used by supported versions for TLS-secret capture workflows.
use_case: Use only for authorized TLS troubleshooting on supported BIG-IP releases.
notes: F5 documentation describes --f5 ssl beginning with BIG-IP 15.x.

title: Capture TLS with F5 SSL metadata
description: Captures TLS traffic with F5 SSL information on supported BIG-IP releases.
use_case: Use when authorized decryption/analysis in Wireshark is required.
notes: Treat resulting capture as sensitive because it may enable TLS decryption.

title: Show iRules attached to virtual server
description: Lists iRules associated with a virtual server.
use_case: Use when application behavior may be affected by iRules.

title: Display iRule
description: Displays an iRule definition.
use_case: Use to review iRule logic during troubleshooting.

title: Tail LTM log
description: Streams LTM log output.
use_case: Use during controlled troubleshooting of iRules/LTM events; stop when finished.
